aboutText: Serving Keilor East and Melbourne's west for years, North West Airconditioning delivers expert air conditioning, heating, and cooling solutions. We specialise in ducted systems, split units, and evaporative cooling, using top brands like Fujitsu and ActronAir. As a licensed contractor, we focus on quality workmanship and reliable service to keep your home comfortable year-round.
servicesText: From split system installations to full ducted air conditioning, we offer a comprehensive range of services. Our team handles new setups, repairs, and maintenance, ensuring efficient and reliable climate control for your home or business.
